---
title: "Runtime and Rating"
---

This page examines the relationship between film runtime and IMDb ratings. @fig-runtime-rating shows the rumtime and ratings for each film in the dataset. 

::: {#cell-fig-runtime-rating .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Ratings (0 to 10)")
plt.show()
```

## Mean Rating by Decade

::: {#7eecd10f .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
